Read the lesson *before* the class it's listed under.

::: {.callout-note}
## Checkpoints
The ✓ marks: those Tuesdays open with a ~20-minute individual, on-paper, no-AI checkpoint covering recent convergent standards and re-offering earlier ones. Details on the [grading page](grading.qmd).
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Homework
Homework sets are assigned in weeks 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, and 11.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Base Camp/Side Quest Sessions
... happen on Mondays: [Base Camp](basecamp.qmd)/[Side Quests](sidequests.qmd). (Optional.)
:::
